title: OpenAI responses API support for write_stream
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary I was trying out the new OpenAI [responses API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses) (which OpenAI recommends instead of chat completions for new projects, see [this note](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat) at the top of chat completions docs). I saw [st.write_stream](https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/api-reference/write-magic/st.write_stream) provides automatic support for rendering streaming outputs when using chat completions, which is awesome, but the same support doesn't yet exist for the responses API. Would it be possible to extend `write_stream` with similar support for responses? Thank you! ### Why? The responses API is now recommended by OpenAI, and it'd be great to have first-class support for rendering its streaming output ### How? Add support for passing a generator returned by `openai.responses.create` to `st.write_stream`. Ideally, returned messages, including tool calls, would be incrementally rendered As an example, currently, running the example below: ```python import streamlit as st import openai # Function to handle streaming responses from OpenAI def stream_openai_response(prompt): return openai.responses.create( model="gpt-4o", input=prompt, stream=True, tools=[{"type": "web_search"}] ) # Streamlit UI st.title("OpenAI Responses API Streaming with Tool Calls") st.write("Enter your prompt below to receive a streaming response from OpenAI.") # User input user_input = st.text_area("Your prompt:", height=100) if st.button("Submit"): if user_input: st.write("**Response:**") # Display the streaming response using st.write_stream st.write_stream(stream_openai_response(user_input)) else: st.warning("Please enter a prompt before submitting.") ``` results in raw JSON output: But it'd be great for it to render output messages similar to what we do for chat completions: ### Additional Context _No response_

Hello [USER] 

Totally agree. That would be an awesome feature to have.

In the meantime, here’s a solution I came up with based on your example, in case it’s helpful:

```python
def stream_openai_response(prompt):
    stream = openai.responses.create(
        model="gpt-4o",
        input=prompt,
        stream=True,
        tools=[{"type": "web_search"}]
    )

    for chunk in stream:
        if chunk.type == 'response.output_text.delta':
            yield chunk.delta
```

Best,

Javier

## Update

Streamlit will support this natively with 1.59+
